tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'jam dpal dug gdong nag po'i gcig chog gsum gyi gdams pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog gsum po dang*// gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// snang grags chos rnams rang bzhin med pa la// de ltar ma rtogs sems can snying re rje// de phyir bdag ni gshin rje gshed gyur nas// de rnams sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya// 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal kun bral zhing*// bde las nyams med btang snyoms la gnas shog /

lan gsum/ e ya bhyoḥ ha la sna tshogs las grub rdo rje'i mkhar// gru bzhi me 'bar dug rlangs sprin ltar gtibs// de dbus bdag mdun dam ye dbyer med pa/ khro chu dug gdong mthing ljang dmar ba'i zhal// dbu gsum mchod rten gsum nang rigs gsum mgon// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dgra st+wa tsitta bsnams// rab 'jigs khro bo'i chas rdzogs gshog pa gdengs// sku sked chu srin rngams zhal sbrul chun 'phyo// sku smad gnam lcags phur pas byad ma gzir// gsang yum dug ti nag mo phyag bzhi ma// ral gri lcags kyu lcags sgrog thod khrag 'dzin/ khro bo'i chas rdzogs yab yum gnyis med sbyor// 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag bewa swa ta// za ba ljang dmar chos rgyal drug gis bskor// thugs kar ya hūm̐ sngags kyis bskor ba las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs// nad gdon gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad nas// sangs rgyas sras bcas kun gyi byin rlabs dang*// 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dregs pa'i mthu stobs kun// 'od zer rnam par bsdus nas bdag la bstim// bdag nyid mthu stobs gzi brjid mtshungs med gyur/ du tri ya ma rā dza/ ya ma rakṣa/ kro ta pa tsa la/ kā la rū pa/ a kro rā dza/ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bzla'o// srung dmigs ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya mtha' dag tshud// ya dang hūm̐ las 'od zer khro chung 'phros// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dregs pa'i mthu nus bsdus// bdag dang bsrung bya gur khang rnams la thim// byad ma'i srung 'khor phyi snod 'byung bcud bsdus// srung 'khor la thim sra mkhregs mi 'gyur brtan// byad ma'i tshe bsod srog gi dwangs ma dang*// rang gi bla tshe 'khyams dang khyer ba rnams// 'od zer dzaḥdamar gyis bsdus bdag la thim// skye 'chi 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku ru gyur// rtsa sngags sham bur/ ru ru rakmo raksha ma bhyo dzaḥdzaḥ

zhes yum sngags dang*/ ma ma nṛ bhrūm̐ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ ces bzlas so// zlog dmigs ni/ spyi gtsug mchod rten gsum gyi nang du ni// rta mgrin bya khyung gshin rje'i gshed nag po// spyi bor 'char ka mgrin par myos byed 'bar// snying gar phyag rgya zil gnon gsang gnas su/ kha thun nag po dpung g.yas khrag mtsho khol// dpung g.yon ral pa tshar dgu lus kyi lha// sku las rang 'dra'i khro chung dpag med spros// byad ma lhar bcas g.yul ngo phar bzlog cing*/ khro chung thog ser mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen gyis// byad ma'i lha srung mtshon cha bskal me dang*// dug rlangs gnam lcags byad ma'i steng du brgyabs// myos dang bsreg byas khro chung tshur 'dus te// zhal phyir gzigs te srung zlog las mdzad gyur// dzaḥyig dmar pos tshe bsod nṛ ljang phrogs// rang la bstims shing byad ma'i las sgrib dang*// gshin rje khros pas 'byung ba rnam par 'khrugs// mtshon cha sna tshogs chu rlabs ltar khol bas// byad ma lhar bcas rdul du brlag par gyur// bsnyen sngags la yum sngags btags te/ du tri ya ma rā dza/ ya ma raksha kro ta pa tsa la ti a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad nṛ tri mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog / ces bzlas so// ces pa karma chags med pa'i gcig chog gsum gyi gdams ngag kha bskangs pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tshe dbang kun khyab kyis so/// /
